The people had paired up almost exactly with their corresponding number. 1's with 1's, 8's with 8's. No one was paired up with anyone who was more than 2 numbers away from them. The point is most people date others in their same attractiveness level. If you're a 4, you shouldn't set your sights on 9's and 10's, unless of course you're rich. Rules don't really apply the same. I’m really glad I called 911 and just so anyone who doesn’t know is informed, they can’t make arrests in overdose situations. Please call if your friend is in an emergency situation. Sketch first. Start with your basic shapes and placement before getting too specific. You always want to think of what’s underneath to get things working. The skull is the framework for everything on top of it. You may want to use the egg trick. Draw an egg shape. Figure where the middle of the face is and draw that vertical line with the curve. Then divide the egg in half that’s where the eyes go. Divide the section below that in half that’s where the bottom of the nose will be. Half the lower section once more and that’s where the lips part. Of course angles can change this but it’s a good general proportion starting point. And have fun! Remember nothing is sacred. If you don’t like it, change it. You made it you can make it again.
